name: Wields Anomalous Artifacts
description: You have the ability to use and control various anomalous artifacts safely.
connectionOptions: One PC is fascinated by your artifacts and always wants to study them.
You once used an artifact to save one PC's life.
One PC distrusts your reliance on anomalous objects.

abilities.name: Artifact Attunement
abilities.description: You are trained in identifying and safely handling anomalous artifacts.

abilities.name: Controlled Activation
abilities.description: You can activate one known anomalous artifact without rolling on the mishap table.

abilities.name: Artifact Shield
abilities.description: You can use artifacts to create a shield that gives you +1 to Armor for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Synergistic Use
abilities.description: You can use two artifacts simultaneously without increasing the chance of mishaps.

abilities.name: Artifact Overcharge
abilities.description: You can overcharge an artifact, doubling its effect but burning it out in the process.

abilities.name: Artifact Creation
abilities.description: You can attempt to create a temporary anomalous artifact once per day.

abilities.name: Reality Rewrite
abilities.description: Once per session, you can use multiple artifacts to rewrite a small aspect of reality within long range.
